Product Engineer — PostHog

PostHog is hiring a Product Engineer to build product analytics and experimentation features used by thousands of companies.

Responsibilities:
- Ship full-stack features across our React frontend and Python/Django backend
- Own problems end-to-end from discovery through production
- Collaborate with product and design on customer-facing workflows

Requirements:
- Strong experience with TypeScript and React
- Comfortable with Python or a similar backend language
- Experience shipping product features in a fast-moving SaaS company
- Clear written communication in an async, remote culture

Nice to have:
- Familiarity with ClickHouse, Postgres, or analytical databases
- Prior experience with product analytics or experimentation products

Senior Backend Engineer — GitLab

GitLab is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to work on the DevSecOps platform.

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement Ruby on Rails / Go services that power GitLab.com
- Improve reliability and performance for large-scale git and CI workloads
- Partner with security and product on secure-by-default features

Requirements:
- 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience
- Strong experience with Ruby on Rails or Go
- Experience operating services at scale
- Excellent written communication in a remote-first handbook culture

Nice to have:
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure
- Prior contributions to open-source DevOps tooling
